correctness.rationale: The helper matches the inspectable contract: PR-number validation, INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, allow-list load with lowercase/[bot] normalization, head SHA checks before and after each GraphQL snapshot with SHA_CHANGED exit 3, paginated reviews and reviewThreads fetching, terminal-state gating (APPROVED/CHANGES_REQUESTED/COMMENTED/DISMISSED vs PENDING), unresolved allow-listed thread counting via comments.nodes[0].author.login, QUIET_ELAPSED when quiet age meets QUIET_WINDOW, TIMEOUT at MAX_WAIT, API_ERROR on missing deps/allow-list/gh failures, and RESULT=/HEAD= stdout with extended fields. Bats fixtures assert all five RESULT branches with matching exit codes 0/2/3/4. One-point deduction: summarize_snapshot sets current_head_terminal only when participating_bots length > 0, so a PR with zero participating bots and zero unresolved threads waits for QUIET_ELAPSED instead of immediate CONVERGED despite vacuously satisfying the stated dual condition.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear and repo-consistent: set -euo pipefail, structured helpers (emit_result, collect_snapshot, summarize_snapshot, api_error), canonical bot-allowlist.txt, GraphQL pagination loops, cross-platform iso_to_epoch, and focused companion updates across pr-resolve-all.md (preferred helper, result dispatch table, preserved manual quiet-window fallback), op-issue-workflow.md halt-gate wording, AI_REPO_GUIDE.md inventory/usage, and scripts/lib/tests README tables. Check wiring follows existing patterns (010 required-files, 142 run_bats_check). One-point deduction: the large inline jq block is not extracted under scripts/lib/jq/ like peer helpers, and scripts/README.md lists a live PR example in verification guidance.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly scoped to eleven on-task files (helper, allow-list, bats, dedicated check, required prompt/guide/README updates) with no forbidden live-state surfaces, in-memory-only polling, explicit pre-#321 boundary respected, documented time-based fallback retained in pr-resolve-all.md, and objective process checks at full 15/15 with 2/2 doc companions touched.

reliability.rationale: Verification wiring is structurally sound: scripts/checks/142-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh invokes run_bats_check; pr-resolve-all-poll.bats stubs gh and sleep and asserts CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR paths with matching exit codes; objective evidence confirms bash -n, lint-shell-conventions, and test_wiring 2/2 pass. One-point deduction: objective-grade.json skipped bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh so runtime pass is unconfirmed in this bundle, and bats fixtures only supply empty reviewThreads—no case exercises unresolved bot threads, pagination, or gh-auth API_ERROR despite those code paths existing in the helper.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective-grade.json; subjective reliability assumes stub-based bats cases are structurally sound but not runtime-verified in this bundle.

polling loop reads HEAD_BEFORE, collects GraphQL snapshot, reads HEAD_AFTER, and emits SHA_CHANGED exit 3 when either differs from SNAPSHOT_HEAD

current_head_terminal requires participating_bots length > 0 and zero nonterminal bots, blocking immediate CONVERGED when no bots participated
collect_snapshot paginates reviews and reviewThreads while hasNextPage is true
